## Checklist-accuracy findings / fixture gaps

These go to the wave anchor #25807. Per the card they are not extracted, and no ledger edit is made in this run.

**Wave-1 findings for these 23 items:** all re-checked against the current revisions. Every one is fixed except one: the stale header of `showcase-crud-persona-matrix.dogfood.test.ts` (it says 6 delegate × sys_* rows, while the matrix has 4, and it calls the `sys_user` read self-scoped).

New findings:

- **`access-security.crud-permission-matrix` automated.ref (a):** it says a delegate's out-of-subtree `sys_user_position` create answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`. Live and in `showcase-permission-zoo.dogfood.test.ts` it now answers `403 DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION`.
- **`access-security.walled-environment-metadata-operator-only`:**
  - knownGaps still says no example app declares the multi-org runtime, but the showcase does, and it booted isolated from the stock tree.
  - steps[0] names `showcase_member_access`, which the showcase does not define. The probe therefore tests a create, not an edit.
  - The title names install-local, but no step drives it; only the pins cover it.
- **`cli.dev-boot-contract` steps[4] and steps[9] are stale after #26130:** `os dev` now compiles by default when a config exists. A boot "without --compile" therefore prints no staleness warning, so the step needs `--no-compile`. The RUNNER OS_PORT-connector environment fact ("`os dev` boots the prebuilt dist unless `--compile` is passed") is dated by the same change.
- **`platform-core.v18-boot-refusals`:**
  - acc[0].verify still prescribes `--maxWorkers=2`.
  - steps[1]'s rig stack must declare at least one object. Without one it dies with "Dependency 'com.objectstack.engine.objectql' not found" before the refusal.
- **v17 fixture recipe** (v18-boot-refusals and ceremony `fixtures.requires`): `npm install @objectstack/cli@17.7.0` needs `--legacy-peer-deps` on npm 10.9.4. Without it the install dies with "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')".
- **`ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed`:** on `os start`, stdio answers tool calls before the HTTP listener is up, so the REST comparison legs must wait for health 200.
- **`platform-core.seed-integrity` acc[1]:** `f_password` reads back as the mask "••••••••". A literal Specimen diff therefore shows one difference; the item should list the field as expected-masked.
- **`automation.packaged-flow-disable-durable` steps 2/8/10:** the task POST also needs `title`. `showcase_task` has no `name` field, and a body using `name` answers 400 INVALID_FIELD.
- **`integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix`:**
  - The Postgres recipe cannot put the data or socket dir under a session scratchpad: the parent chain is root 0700, and the socket path exceeds the 107-byte limit. What works is a `/tmp/RUN-pg` dir with `unix_socket_directories=''`, TCP only.
  - A failed connect surfaces its real cause only in the create response's `statusReason`. `POST /:name/test` answers "no registered driver to introspect".
- **`platform-core.boot-health`:**
  - The canonical `os dev` compile prints 65 author-time ⚠ lint lines before the server starts, which a ⚠ grep over the boot log hits. The item does not scope them out.
  - At the default log level no boot line names the Console mount path; it had to be proven by CLI resolution plus a bundle hash.
- **`platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render`:**
  - knownGaps[2] quotes "HTTP 502 · fetch failed". The page now reads "Failed to load marketplace — The marketplace catalog could not be reached." The wire is still 502 `MARKETPLACE_PROXY_FAILED`.
  - The console-added `reports` sidebar entry per app is not mentioned. It was walked in both apps.
- **`approvals.account-app-entry`:**
  - The fixture recipe does not say the invoice's account must be active. The first seeded account (Wonka Brands, churned) answers 400 "This account has churned".
  - acc[3]'s evidence door (`GET /approvals/requests/:id`) carries no timeline. The appended row is readable only from `sys_approval_action`, and `/approvals/requests/:id/history` is 404.
  - acc[0] has the runner run `pnpm console:build` itself.
- **`records-forms.crud-roundtrip`:**
  - The Accounts entry sits in the collapsed "Data Model" group.
  - The buttons read "Create" and "Update", not "Save".
  - acc[4].verify still cites the retired console pin `cf153eb2e535`; the spec is `ui/e2e/live/record-history-display.spec.ts`.
- **`studio-authoring.first-run-loop` steps:** the New-object and Create-app dialogs confirm with "Save as draft", not "Create". Pin F1 (`ui/e2e/live/studio-object-designer.spec.ts`) was not run because it needs the console dev server, so acc[0] was scored by hand (RUNNER option a).

Fixture gaps, parked on #25807:
- the rls D11 private write-up;
- the guest anchor;
- the 18.0.0-next.*-born DB;
- the walled `group` posture was not booted, so that side of the walled item rests on its pins;
- no HTTP door places the walled org-scoped `manage_metadata` grant;
- the marketplace catalog needs egress to cloud.objectos.ai (the named error state was scored);
- no fixture throws inside a route, so the ErrorBoundary clause stands on "none encountered".

Tree hygiene: the repo tree stayed clean (`git status --short` empty), and `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/` never existed. Three gitignored by-products remain in the checkout; a repo guard hook refused their deletion from the runner seats:
- `examples/app-showcase/e2e/.auth/state.json` (the smoke pin's storage state, for a stopped boot);
- `examples/app-showcase/test-results/`;
- `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/data/showcase_external.db` (the showcase's external datasource file, created by stock-tree boots).

## Off-clause probes (RUNNER rule 8)

About 55 minutes across five runners, after every clause had a verdict, on the same boots.

**Doors probed:**
- bulk and side write doors (createMany owner forge, updateMany, deleteMany, `/batch`);
- by-id data doors;
- public-form submit with a forged owner;
- walled self-escalation (self-grant `admin_full_access`, PATCH its own grant row);
- query params ($top/$skip bad values; empty $filter, $select and $orderby; $in [null]; $between reversed or 3-valued; $regex);
- `_activation` and `/actions`;
- datasource admin and meta doors (unknown name, inline password, `secret: ""`, member writes);
- MCP stdio (empty and whitespace keys, admin key, `sys_user` exposure, formula-field aggregates);
- ceremony re-apply, and `os start` / `os dev` over a v17 DB;
- meta/app `?id=` variants (empty, duplicate, case, whitespace);
- settings namespaces, sign-in and sign-out boundaries;
- console bad routes;
- the approvals approve door (double approve, unknown id, actorId forge);
- clone overrides, Studio package and object doors.

**Personas:** admin, operator, walled org owner, baseline and contributor-bound members, liaison, approver, seeded member Mei, anonymous, and a bogus bearer.

**Result:** nothing passed the filing gate.

Observed, not filed (no declared contract, or by design):
- `_activation` with an empty body enables the action; `enabled` is documented as optional.
- `PATCH /datasources/:name {secret:""}` binds an empty secret and flips `hasSecret` to true.
- `POST …/clone {overrides:"x"}` answers 201 and ignores the non-object.
- `…/view/view_nope` silently renders the default list rather than a named not-found.
- A prefix-less object is accepted as a draft and refused only at publish (NAMESPACE_PREFIX).
- `os dev` over a v17 DB upgrades in place with a backup. That is the documented dev path; the items judge `os serve`.
- History shows a currency value raw.
- At 1366 px, a tab click on the Setup user record page scrolls the main region sideways (seen once, cosmetic).
